purpose: Implement the complete production-grade, operator-supervised mike_trade application specified by the accompanying read-only PRODUCT_SPEC.md (version 1.2, Oct 8 2026). All core functionality is in-scope: one buy/one full sell per stock; Python buy/sell plugins; Alpaca equity broker adapter with future interchangeable brokers/data/research; shared IEX stream; central scheduler and constrained concurrent execution; SQLite ledgers; budgets, daily entry caps, losing streak buy lockouts, post-sale cooldown; fixed/native continuous/independent stepped trailing stops; fractional fills and stop coordination; simultaneous shadow/paper/live without cross-account leakage; deterministic backtests; independent read-only OFFLINE-capable dashboard; operational CLI/Make targets, reporting, logging, recovery, documentation, security and acceptance. The project is not an MVP or demo; do not declare complete while any required module is a stub. Treat Alpaca account-dependent paper checks as pending operator-provided credentials, never as permission to run live orders. The source specification is authoritative when this skeleton does not repeat a detail. Include a working VWAP bounce BUY + VWAP breakdown SELL reference pair, shadow-only config and deterministic end-to-end evidence as actual deliverables (never a demo or profitable-alpha claim).
async_strategy: 20 sequential single-letter phases a through t, with exactly five planned materialized tasks per phase (100 total); NEVER generate extra tasks, merge hints or alter hint model assignments. Within each phase the explicit async_notes define waves; only tasks with disjoint allowed_write_paths can run concurrently. All tasks in later waves depend on relevant tasks from earlier waves within the same phase. No cross-phase dependencies in TaskDocument; phase ordering is sufficient. Materialize one phase at a time if needed for reliable counts. Pin each backend/model exactly as task_hints specify: 20 codex_cli/gpt-5.6-sol; 20 claude_code_cli/claude-sonnet-5-5; 20 codex_cli/gpt-6-luna; 40 pi_cli/openrouter/meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor. Materialization/planning backend is separate from execution backend assignment; do not use --backend as a blanket routing override or allow a planning model to bleed into execution tasks. For PI, OpenRouter transport uses the composite OpenRouter model slug and requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY; verify PI_PROVIDER/openrouter route. Each generated task must have title, nonempty description, exact concrete allowed_write_paths, scoped measurable acceptance_criteria, allowed_symbols/forbidden_changes when useful, focused verification_commands, and reasonable task_timeout_seconds. Verification-only tasks must write a real test or audit artifact. Use targeted tests after each task only; no broad suites/backtests as incidental progress checks. No strategy model or executor may access broker live credentials during planning or ordinary unit tests.
cost_estimate: high: 100 bounded implementation tasks across 20 phases; model distribution 20% GPT-5.6 Sol, 20% Claude Sonnet 5.5, 20% GPT-6 Luna, 40% PI/OpenRouter Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor; no implied dollar quote
operator_questions: Before account-dependent Alpaca PAPER verification (not materialization): operator must provide paper credentials and approve placing test paper orders. Without credentials, mark this acceptance step PENDING; never falsify a pass.
Before any real LIVE execution: operator must explicitly enable account-specific live mode and review preflight, risk caps, stop/fractional capabilities; no live order is authorized by this skeleton.
Before enabling native/stepped protective stops for fractional shares: check actual Alpaca paper account restrictions; unsupported configurations must fail closed, not be simulated as live.
Specify target git repository root and materialization plan directory; expected_changed_files are relative to the new standalone mike_trade repository root.
